title: p7-plugin-controller
purpose: Proves plugin:java-controller (R10): an author-supplied @RestController mounted from the app definition directory, and that security.minimumRole is ENFORCED at request time by a generated wrapper (D9), not merely declared and trusted.
walkthrough: A FIXTURE, not a demo. Driven by scripts/proofs/run-r10-plugin-controller-proof.py.
adminTools (minimumRole=ADMIN) proves the mount serves a real HTTP request end to end.
superOnlyTools (minimumRole=SUPERUSER) proves the SAME caller that succeeds against adminTools is rejected -- dev/auth.mode=none never auto-grants SUPERUSER.
expectedOutcomes: GET /api/plugins/admin-tools/ping with the dev API key returns 200 {ok:true}.
GET /api/plugins/super-only/ping with the SAME dev API key returns 403.
